sentences.text: 3 29-01-2013 Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 147, 341, 323, 353, 379, 427 of the I.P.C. and Section 135 of the Electricity Act.
The present anticipatory bail application has been filed since anticipatory bail application was pending before learned Sessions Judge vide A.B.P. No. 01 of 2012.

The report of the learned Sessions Judge suggests that A.B.P. No. 01 of 2012 relates to one Jugeshwar Prasad registered under Sections 272, 273 of the I.P.C. and 63 and 59(iii) of the Food Safety and Standard Act.

Annexure-2 is the photocopy of the certified copy which reflects A.B.P.
Number of the petitioner as A.B.P. No. 1 of 2012.
There is some mistake in the records of learned Sessions Judge.
Let the anticipatory bail application of the petitioner be verified, detected and disposed off within a period of one month from the date of receipt/production of the copy of this order.
With the observations above, the application stands disposed off.
Let the order of this Court be transmitted through FAX to the learned Court below at the cost of the petitioner.

(Dinesh Kumar Singh, J) Shageer/-
